criteria.passage: I’d first ask the customer to walk me through what happened when they tried to place the order, so I can see whether the confirmation simply failed to arrive or whether the purchase may not have gone through.
criteria.rationale: This directly shows the candidate would clarify what problem the customer is experiencing by investigating whether the issue is a missing confirmation or an unsuccessful purchase.

criteria.passage: I’d also note the unfamiliar delivery address and check whether it matches any shipping details on the account.
criteria.rationale: This identifies the affected outcome/service as the delivery/address details tied to the order, showing the candidate is checking what part of the customer experience is impacted.

criteria.passage: I’d make sure we have the order details in front of us before deciding on the next step.
criteria.rationale: This indicates the candidate would gather and review the facts to define the problem before choosing a resolution, which is consistent with summarising the issue first.

annotation.annotation_notes: The answer addresses the missing confirmation, possible failed purchase, and unfamiliar address, and it proposes checking order details before acting.
